expected: The comparison marks this row Same; the app's UI should render in a sandbox as on web, or the row should be Partial.
actual: A warning plus raw text on every app card.
impact: Connector apps look broken on mobile.
fix: Render the MCP App resource in a sandboxed WebView using the web host contract, or change the parity row to Partial and word the card as a summary rather than a failure.
verify: Manual: run a connector app turn on the phone; the app renders. Jest: card renders a WebView for a resource URI.

feature: Send button
title: Every send writes the prompt into a persisted queue and removes it again, a queue that never holds anything but can show a jargon 'lane is at capacity' alert.
expected: No unused queue on the send path; prompt text not written to disk for no purpose.
actual: Two MMKV writes of the prompt per send and an unreachable alert.
impact: No user-visible effect; needless disk writes of message text.
fix: Remove getMobileSendQueue from sendMessage and delete lib/sendQueue.ts if nothing else uses it.
verify: rg getMobileSendQueue returns only tests; send tests still pass.

feature: Regenerate or retry a reply
title: The three-retry limit and retry backoff never apply, because each retry creates a new message id and the counter is keyed by id.
expected: Either the limit counts attempts per question, or the dead limit and backoff are removed.
actual: Unlimited immediate retries; dead alert copy.
impact: Low; possible rapid repeated paid retries.
fix: Key retryAttempts by the user question id (anchorMessageId), or delete the limit.
verify: Unit test: three failed retries of one question show the limit alert.

feature: Offline queueing of a sent message
title: Online detection depends on OS internet validation, so a network that blocks the OS check can make Cloud sends queue forever.
expected: A device that can reach the AGI API is treated as online.
actual: Possibly treated as offline; every Cloud message is queued and never replayed.
impact: Unknown share of users; total send failure for them.
fix: NetInfo.configure with reachabilityUrl set to an AGI health endpoint and useNativeReachability false, or treat a successful API call as online.
verify: Close the loop on an Android device with connectivitycheck.gstatic.com blocked: check isInternetReachable and whether a send queues.

feature: Start a new chat from the home screen
title: Offline, a message in an existing Cloud chat is queued but the first message of a new chat is refused with an alert.
expected: One offline behaviour, or copy on the composer that says new chats need a connection before typing.
actual: Typed text is kept but the user learns only on Send.
impact: Small confusion.
fix: Show the offline state on the home composer before send, or create the conversation lazily and queue.
verify: Manual offline check on home.

feature: Upgrade pill on home or in the side menu
title: The Upgrade chip is built but hidden because mobile v1 has no in-app purchase.
expected: Hidden until purchases exist.
actual: Hidden.
impact: None; owner decision: mobile v1 free with no IAP, no subscription sales before 2027-01-01.
fix: None.
verify: None.

feature: Finances, companion and link-browser choice
title: Bank linking, the companion screen and the in-app or system browser choice are built but switched off in v1.
expected: Hidden in v1.
actual: Hidden; code ships unused.
impact: None for users.
fix: None; revisit when the flags change.
verify: None.

feature: Search chats, projects and files page
title: Search finds files and generated images only in chats already loaded on the phone, and ignores the files the server returns.
expected: File matches the server returns appear in mobile search, as they do in web's search dialog.
actual: Server file matches are dropped; files and images from chats not loaded on the phone are missing from those groups, while the Library screen (server-backed, libraryClient.ts:118) and web's search dialog (GlobalSearchDialog.tsx:682) list them.
impact: Cross-device users conclude the file is gone; parity with web search is broken.
fix: Map data.files (and documents if shown) from /api/search into remote file matches and merge them like remoteSearchProjects; for images, query the library endpoint or add an image kind to the search response.
verify: Store test: a mocked /api/search response with files yields file results; manual: upload a file on web, search its name on the phone.

feature: Add photos or files during a voice conversation
title: Attachments added from the voice bar skip the per-message file count and total size checks the composer applies.
expected: Voice attachments are admitted with the same count and total-size rules as the composer, with the same alert.
actual: A user can stage more files or bytes than one message carries; every file is uploaded through /api/uploads/presign, which counts it against the daily upload limit (presign/route.ts:132 admitAttachmentUpload), then the server leaves the extras out and the chat marks them truncated (chatExecutionStore.ts:3475 onAttachmentsTruncated).
impact: The user learns after sending that files were left out, and daily upload allowance is spent on them.
fix: Use admitAttachments(attachmentsRef.current, items, appMode, tier) in useVoiceAttachments.addAttachments.
verify: Hook test: staging maxFilesPerMessage + 1 photos through the voice target rejects the last one with the composer's message.

feature: Turn memory of past chats on or off
title: The Cloud branch of past-chat retrieval on the phone is never called, and the store privacy notes still describe it.
expected: No unreachable Cloud retrieval code, and store disclosures that match what the app sends.
actual: Dead code that would also write search history if revived (it omits track=false); disclosure overstates one data flow.
impact: Maintainers may revive a path that duplicates server context and records searches the user never made.
fix: Delete searchCloudHistory and the Cloud branch, narrow retrievePastChatContext to Local, and update the data-safety and reviewer-note rows.
verify: Typecheck and the chatExecutionStore past-chat tests; grep shows no Cloud caller.

feature: Voice data consent sheet
title: The live voice disclosure says audio goes to 'the voice provider' without naming it.
expected: Likely: the app names who receives the audio and gets an explicit yes. Whether the current App Store rule requires naming the provider was not verified.
actual: The provider is unnamed; Continue serves as the only consent.
impact: Possible App Store review risk under the third-party AI data-sharing rule, and users do not know who hears them.
fix: Name the live voice provider from the registry (not a literal) in the disclosure and label the button as agreement; link to the privacy section.
verify: Check the current App Store Review Guideline 5.1.2 text; component test for the provider name in the live disclosure.

feature: Artifacts switch
title: The Artifacts switch on the phone promises a side preview that the phone does not have.
expected: Copy that matches the phone: artifacts open full screen.
actual: Web wording on a phone screen.
impact: Minor confusion about what the switch does.
fix: Change the description, for example 'Create apps, documents and diagrams you can open full screen.'
verify: Snapshot or text assertion on the capabilities screen.

feature: Search the project list
title: Project search never includes shared projects, and switching to Shared with a search typed shows No matches with no field to clear it.
expected: Search covers shared projects; changing the filter clears or keeps a visible search.
actual: Type a query under All, switch to Shared with you: the shared list disappears and 'No project matches' shows with no search bar to clear. Under All, shared projects never match a query.
impact: Team users think shared projects are missing.
fix: Filter the shared section by the query too, and either keep the search bar under Shared or clear the query in setFilterChoice.
verify: Screen test: with query 'x' and filter shared, the shared section filters by 'x' and a search field is visible.

feature: Voice settings page
title: Voice settings say only the transcript goes to AGI Cloud, but live voice streams raw audio to a third-party voice provider.
expected: The settings page states that in Cloud voice conversations audio goes to the voice provider.
actual: It understates what leaves the device.
impact: Misleading privacy statement; store review and user trust risk.
fix: Rewrite the caption to cover both paths: dictation transcribes on device; Cloud voice conversations stream audio to the named voice provider.
verify: Text assertion on the voice settings screen.

feature: Edit part of an image by selecting an area
title: Editing an area of an image from the Library skips the model's edit-support check and always asks for a square 1024x1024 result.
expected: Same check and the source aspect ratio, as in chat.
actual: Users see a 'Editing the image' toast, then an error for models that cannot edit; wide or tall images come back square.
impact: Wasted attempts and distorted results.
fix: Reuse imageEditTarget/serverEditsImages before showing the control and derive size from the source image.
verify: Test: a library image from a non-editing model shows no Edit area; a 16:9 source sends a matching size.

feature: Skills the assistant can load (create, import, install, use in chat)
title: Skill import calls the file picker outside its error handling and uploads without token refresh or a size check.
expected: Picker and upload failures show the import error; expired tokens refresh; oversize files are refused before upload.
actual: A picker error is silent; an expired token reports 'Could not import this skill'.
impact: Occasional silent failures on import.
fix: Move the picker into the try, route the upload through the api client's auth refresh, and check size against the server limit first.
verify: Unit test: a rejecting picker sets importError; a 401 retries once after refresh.

feature: More actions menu on a project page
title: When a phone edit to a project conflicts with a web edit, the phone's change is dropped without telling the user.
expected: Field-level merge for independent fields (pin, archive, name), or a visible notice that the change was not kept.
actual: The pin, archive or rename made on the phone silently reverts.
impact: Rare but confusing lost edits for cross-device users.
fix: Merge non-overlapping fields on conflict and re-push, or show a toast naming the change that was not saved.
verify: Sync engine test: conflict with a server rename keeps the local starred flag.

feature: Images page with Templates and Trending ideas
title: The Images page never shows Templates or Ideas tiles, because nothing supplies them.
expected: Templates and Ideas starter tiles appear, as the feature map and web describe.
actual: Users always see the 'Create an image' empty state; the tab switch, tile grid and pickTile are dead code.
impact: Every user misses the starter tiles; the parity claim for this row is false.
fix: Load templates and ideas from the server source web uses (or the shared catalog) in the route and pass them in, or remove the unused tab and grid.
verify: Screen test rendering the route shows the Templates tab and tiles when the source returns data.

feature: Skills the assistant can load (create, import, install, use in chat)
title: Importing a skill whose scan needs review always fails on the phone, because there is no way to acknowledge the scan.
expected: The phone shows the scan findings and lets the user import anyway, resending with the acknowledgement, as web does.
actual: The same refusal repeats on every attempt.
impact: Users cannot import such skills on mobile at all.
fix: Parse the 409 refusal details (findings, acknowledgements), show them in an Alert with Import anyway, and resend with PLUGIN_UPLOAD_ACKNOWLEDGED_SCAN_FIELD set to the hash.
verify: Service test: a 409 scan_review_required then a resend with the acknowledgement succeeds; manual import of a caution-level skill.

feature: Filter the library by kind of item
title: The Library offers a Videos filter that says 'Videos you generate will appear here' although the phone cannot create videos.
expected: Hide the chip when no video source exists on the phone, or say videos made on the web show here; filter by kind on the server.
actual: An empty Videos view that promises a feature the phone lacks; kind filters can look empty until more pages load.
impact: Minor confusion.
fix: Gate the chip on FEATURES.videoGen or the presence of video assets, reword the empty copy, and pass kind to libraryListPath for the kind chips.
verify: Screen test: with videoGen off and no video assets, no Videos chip; request includes kind=image for the Images chip.

feature: Start a new coding session
title: Each Start session tap makes a new requestId, so a retry after a lost response creates a second session and uses another sandbox slot.
expected: One requestId per sheet opening (per draft), reused on retry, so the server returns the existing session.
actual: A retry provisions a duplicate session; on a 1-2 session plan the user then hits 'Your plan allows N active Code sessions'.
impact: Duplicate sandboxes, wasted compute, false limit errors.
fix: Create the requestId when the sheet opens or the draft changes and keep it across retries until success.
verify: Unit test: two handleCreate calls after a rejected first call send the same requestId.

feature: Choose the environment for a session
title: The phone offers coding harnesses labelled 'needs your own API key' but has no field for the key, so choosing one always fails.
expected: Mobile hides or disables runtimes that need a user credential (BYOK is out of scope for the phone).
actual: The user can pick it and gets a refusal after tapping Start.
impact: Dead option and a confusing error.
fix: Filter runtimes with needsUserCredential out of the mobile picker, or disable them with a note.
verify: Component test: a runtime with needsUserCredential is not selectable.

feature: Start a new coding session
title: If a new session fails to provision, the task the user typed is never sent and is not put back in the composer.
expected: On a failed provision the goal is restored into the composer or shown with a retry.
actual: The typed task silently disappears; the user sees a failed session with an empty composer.
impact: User retypes the task.
fix: When the session reaches failed or closed with an unsent initialGoal, set the draft to the goal.
verify: Component test: session moves provisioning to failed with goal param; composer shows the goal.

feature: Manage cloud environments
title: The Cloud environments screen ships but nothing opens it, and sessions cannot use a saved environment anyway.
expected: Either a reachable environments feature wired into session creation, or no shipped screen.
actual: Unreachable screen with list and swipe delete that talks to /api/code/environments.
impact: Dead code in the bundle; maintenance cost; misleading for audits.
fix: Remove the route and cloudCodeEnvironments.ts from mobile, or link it from Code settings and pass environmentId on create.
verify: git grep shows a caller, or the files are gone and tests updated.

feature: Connect an outside app from its row
title: Connector connect and AGI Work start replace the server's reason (plan, workspace policy, rate limit) with a generic 'Try again'.
expected: The alert states why: not on your plan, blocked by your workspace, or try later.
actual: Users retry an action that cannot succeed.
impact: Confusing failures; support load.
fix: Show ConnectorPolicyError and ApiHttpError messages for 403/429 with a user-safe body; same for startCloudWorkRun errors carrying a server message.
verify: Unit tests: a 403 with plan_upgrade_required shows the plan message.

feature: Run a schedule from an event (Gmail, Slack, calendar, GitHub, webhook)
title: A 'Scheduled task needs your approval' push opens the generic Scheduled list instead of the run that is waiting.
expected: The tap opens that schedule's run history with the Approve and Deny controls.
actual: User must find the schedule and open History by hand.
impact: Slower approvals; runs stay paused longer.
fix: Pass taskId and runId in the push data and route to the schedule's history view.
verify: Unit test of handleNotificationResponse with schedule_run and taskId pushes the history route.

feature: Scheduled task caps by plan
title: Free users (every public mobile v1 user) cannot create schedules, connect connectors, start AGI Work or open Code sessions; screens show the plan note without a purchase path.
expected: Per owner decisions: mobile v1 free with no IAP, no subscription sales before 2027-01-01.
actual: As expected; only comped accounts reach these flows on the phone.
impact: None beyond the decision; most of this unit is reachable only by comped accounts.
fix: None.
verify: None.

feature: File library across chats
title: The Library shows Free accounts storage and download meters with their limits ('X of Y file storage used', 'X of Y file downloads used this month'), against the owner rule that Free sees only Upgrade.
expected: On Free the Library shows no usage meters or limits (at most an Upgrade action), as Settings > Usage does.
actual: Free users on phone and web see storage and download meters with their caps.
impact: Free users see limit meters the owner has repeatedly ruled out.
fix: Omit the meter fields for Free in /api/library (server decides), or hide them in both clients for Free and show Upgrade when a cap is hit; add a test like UsageSection's Free test.
verify: Route test: a Free account's /api/library response has no storage_limit_bytes or download_* fields; component tests on phone and web that a Free Library shows no meter text.

feature: Chat font preference
title: A dyslexic font preference is stored and synced but no screen sets it and nothing applies it
expected: A reachable font choice that changes chat text, or no stored preference.
actual: The value syncs to the cloud and is exported, but the user cannot change it and it has no effect.
impact: Users who need a dyslexia-friendly font have no option although the data model promises one.
fix: Add the picker and apply the font, or remove the field from the store and the sync mapping.
verify: Pick the font in Settings and see chat text change; or confirm the field is gone.

feature: Edit an image (source, mask and reference images)
title: The phone sizes edit images to the 12,000,000-character contract limit, but the server refuses any request body over 4 MiB.
expected: The client bounds the whole request under the server's body ceiling, or the route's ceiling matches its contract.
actual: A PNG of about 3 MB or more that is already within 2048 px is sent unshrunk, and several images together can also pass 4 MiB; the server answers 413 before the handler runs.
impact: Some image edits fail with a size error the phone's own check said was fine.
fix: Share one request-size constant between the contract, the ceiling table and both clients; shrink until the full body fits.
verify: Test: a 2048 px PNG of 3.5 MB as source produces a body under the ceiling, or the route accepts it.

feature: Sign out from the editor
title: Sign-out says 'Signed out of AGI Cloud' with no warning when the CLI cannot be reached, though the CLI on this machine may still hold a working login.
expected: Sign-out ends the CLI login too, or says plainly that the CLI is still signed in and how to sign it out.
actual: The editor reports success; depending on token state the CLI either keeps working and is re-adopted, or later fails with 'session ended'.
impact: Users on shared machines believe they signed out of AGI on this computer.
fix: Treat 'unavailable' like 'failed' and offer a 'Sign out the CLI' action that runs agi logout in a terminal; block adoption until an explicit sign-in after a sign-out.
verify: Unit test: logout() returns {status:'unavailable'} and a warning is shown; manual: sign out with no folder open, open a trusted folder, Account & Usage still shows signed out.

feature: Inline diffs with accept or reject
title: Pending code-block proposals keep their original ranges, so accepting one proposal or any edit above another makes the others fail as stale.
expected: Accepting one proposal, or typing elsewhere in the file, shifts the remaining proposals and keeps them acceptable.
actual: Accept one by one top-down and every later proposal is refused; highlighted lines drift off the code they describe.
impact: Users accepting suggestions one at a time lose them and must ask again.
fix: Track sessions with an onDidChangeTextDocument listener that rebases ranges through each content change (or anchor them as decorations) and compare against the rebased range.
verify: Unit test: two sessions at lines 2 and 10, accept the first which adds 3 lines, then acceptDiff on the second returns true and writes at line 13.

feature: Inline diffs with accept or reject
title: Batch accept and reject (CodeLens and two commands) can never appear because no caller creates a batch.
expected: Either a producer sets batchId and confidence, or the code is removed.
actual: Unreachable UI and commands.
impact: Maintenance cost; the contributed commands suggest a feature that does not exist.
fix: Delete batch and confidence support from DiffSession, the CodeLens provider, the commands and package.json, or wire a multi-file proposal producer.
verify: grep shows no batchId producer; after removal the diff tests still pass.

feature: Restore rejected edits
title: Restore Rejected Diffs only brings back the most recent rejection; earlier rejected proposals are lost without notice.
expected: Restore returns every change rejected in this session, or the copy says it restores the last rejection.
actual: Reject A, then reject B: Restore brings back only B.
impact: Users who rejected by mistake earlier cannot get the change back.
fix: Append to the stash (bounded) instead of replacing it, and offer the Restore action after single rejects too.
verify: Unit test: reject two sessions separately, restoreRejected returns both.

feature: Paste or drag in images
title: Image attachment thumbnails use blob: URLs that the chat panel's content security policy blocks, so chips show a broken image.
expected: A thumbnail of the pasted screenshot, or a file icon.
actual: A broken-image glyph in each image chip.
impact: Every user attaching images sees a broken preview.
fix: Add blob: to img-src for this panel, or render the icon branch for images; call URL.revokeObjectURL when the chip is removed.
verify: Not run here: confirm in a webview that a blob: image is refused under img-src ${cspSource} (CSP rule), then paste a PNG after the fix and see the thumbnail.

feature: Paste or drag in images
title: Dropping more than eight files attaches the first eight and silently ignores the rest.
expected: A notice that only eight files can be attached at once.
actual: Files nine and later vanish with no message.
impact: Users think all files were sent.
fix: Show a failed chip or a status line naming the dropped files.
verify: Webview test: drop 10 files, expect a notice for 2.

feature: Sign-in works when VS Code is connected to a remote machine
title: The main sign-in path (through the CLI) uses the local 2.5 second browser-open timeout and never says the page opens on your own computer.
expected: Both paths use deviceAuthorizationOpenTimeoutMs(remoteName) and describeDeviceAuthorizationBrowser.
actual: In SSH, WSL and container windows users usually get the generic 'Enter code at URL' warning without the remote explanation the feature row claims.
impact: Remote users, minor confusion.
fix: Pass the remote timeout and prepend describeDeviceAuthorizationBrowser in accountAccess.signIn.
verify: Unit test with remoteName 'ssh-remote' expects the remote wording in the CLI path.

feature: Sign in with your own subscription plan from inside the editor
title: Cancelling sign-in leaves the CLI's device login pending because the extension never calls account/login/cancel.
expected: Cancel stops the CLI login so a later browser approval does not sign the machine in.
actual: Approving the page after cancelling still signs the CLI in, and the editor adopts it.
impact: Unexpected sign-in; a dangling request.
fix: When the CLI offers accountLoginCancel, call account/login/cancel with the loginId on cancellation.
verify: Unit test: cancel token fires, adapter receives a cancel call.

feature: Path to the engine executable
title: Check the CLI (/doctor) reports success for a CLI the runtime will refuse as too old.
expected: The check says the version is below the minimum and how to update.
actual: Success message, then chat fails with a version error.
impact: Users with an old CLI get a green check and a broken chat.
fix: Reuse isSupportedCliVersion in cliProbeMessage and report below-minimum as an error.
verify: Unit test: probe with version 0.0.1 returns an error message naming the minimum.

feature: CLI install and version check
title: The CLI installer and release check always use agiworkforce.com, ignoring the configured AGI origin.
expected: Installer and release feed follow the configured origin.
actual: A staging-configured editor checks and installs from production.
impact: Staging testers and internal QA.
fix: Build both URLs from getCloudWebOrigin().
verify: Unit test with apiEndpoint set to staging expects the staging feed URL.

feature: Summarize the session to free context (/compact)
title: Palette commands for compact, status, export and checkpoints always act on the sidebar chat, even when an editor-tab chat is focused.
expected: The palette command acts on the focused chat panel.
actual: Running Code: Summarize Session from an editor chat tab compacts the sidebar session or says there is none.
impact: Users with several chat tabs.
fix: Route these through focusedChat() like forkConversation.
verify: Unit test: focused editor panel receives compactConversation.

feature: Running token and credit counter in the status bar
title: The status bar credit estimate and billed credits show for every plan, while Account & Usage hides session meters on Free.
expected: Free users see no credit meter, consistent with the Free usage rule.
actual: Free users who make managed utility requests see credit figures in the status bar breakdown.
impact: Free users see meters the owner rule says they should not.
fix: Hide the credit rows (or the item) when the cached tier is Free.
verify: Confirm whether Free accounts can make managed requests from the editor (developer_surfaces is PRO_TIERS only, billing-catalog.ts:359); if yes, add a Free test.

feature: Plan usage and limits shown in the editor for paid plans
title: When the account comes only from the CLI, Account & Usage shows usage and billing rows without checking for Free.
expected: Free accounts see only Upgrade in every branch.
actual: A Free CLI account sees usage and billing links and no Upgrade.
impact: Free users in that state.
fix: Apply isFreeBillingPlanTier(cliAccount.cli.tier) in this branch.
verify: Unit test with a Free CLI account and no extension token.

feature: Webview security (message origin)
title: The chat webview accepts any window message without checking its source.
expected: Defense in depth: ignore messages whose event.source is not the parent window.
actual: No check.
impact: Only matters if a future change embeds third-party frames.
fix: Return early unless event.source === window.parent.
verify: Webview test posts a message from a child frame and expects no effect.

feature: Model performance dashboard
title: The model dashboard's inline style attributes are blocked by its own content security policy.
expected: Centered, muted empty-state text.
actual: Unstyled text.
impact: Cosmetic.
fix: Move the style into the nonce'd stylesheet as a class.
verify: Not run here: open the dashboard with no data and check the console for a style-src violation.

feature: Translated interface strings
title: Code-block Apply status strings are hard-coded English.
expected: Strings come from the vscode locale catalog.
actual: English in every locale.
impact: Non-English users.
fix: Add keys to packages/ui/i18n/locales/*/vscode.json and use L10N.
verify: Snapshot test in a non-English locale.

feature: Sign in with your own subscription plan from inside the editor
title: One server error while polling ends the fallback sign-in, and an unreadable success response throws out of the progress notification.
expected: Transient 5xx answers are retried like network errors until the grant expires.
actual: A single 502 from the edge ends sign-in and asks the user to start again.
impact: Occasional failed sign-ins.
fix: Return pending for 5xx (with backoff) and catch parse errors in the loop with a clear message.
verify: Unit test: post returns 502 once then approved; signInToAgiCloud resolves true.

feature: CLI install and version check
title: On Windows the CLI lookup accepts agi.cmd, which Node cannot spawn without a shell.
expected: Only executables that can be spawned are accepted.
actual: A stray agi.cmd is chosen and fails with an unclear spawn error.
impact: Rare.
fix: Drop the .cmd candidate, or skip it and keep searching.
verify: Unit test of resolveCliPath on win32 with only agi.cmd present returns not-found.

feature: Use a project in the chat (/project)
title: The project chosen for chat survives sign-out, so the next account on this workspace sends the previous account's project id and instructions with every turn.
expected: Signing out, or signing in as another account, clears the active project.
actual: After an account switch the composer still shows the old project and turns carry its id and instructions.
impact: Shared machines: one account's project instructions reach another account's turns; the server sees a foreign project id.
fix: Call clearActiveCloudProject and pushActiveProject in the signOut handler and when the signed-in account id changes; store the owner id with the active project and ignore a mismatch.
verify: Unit test: set an active project, run signOut, getActiveCloudProject returns undefined.

feature: Bring a cloud task back into the workspace
title: A cloud-task link may name a branch that starts with a dash, which is then passed to git checkout as an option.
expected: Branch names starting with '-' are rejected when the link is parsed.
actual: A crafted link can ask git to run checkout with an option such as -f, which discards local changes, after two prompts that show the odd branch name.
impact: Data loss for a user who accepts the prompts on a malicious link.
fix: Reject names whose first character, or any path segment's, is '-' (or validate with git check-ref-format --branch), in parse and encode.
verify: Confirm the VS Code git API passes treeish before any '--'; unit test: parseCloudTaskHandoffQuery('runId=a&branch=-f').branch is null.

feature: Skills
title: Installing a skill from a folder has no trust confirmation, unlike plugins, MCP servers and hooks.
expected: The same 'runs on this computer with your permissions' confirmation before a skill is installed.
actual: One click in a file dialog installs it.
impact: Inconsistent consent for content the agent will follow and whose scripts it may run.
fix: Call confirmInstall with the skill's name and what it can do before skillsInstall.
verify: Unit test: cancel the confirm and expect no skillsInstall call.

feature: Session status with context use and plan limits (/status)
title: /status shows 'Not signed in' whenever the CLI cannot answer, even when the editor holds its own session.
expected: The row uses resolveAccountPresence (CLI, then the editor's own token).
actual: Signed-in users see Not signed in.
impact: Confusing account state.
fix: Use resolveAccountPresence for the row and _shownEffort for the effort label.
verify: Unit test: CLI unavailable, stored token present, row says Signed in.

feature: Commit and open a pull request from chat
title: Git Commit commits every tracked change without showing which files go in.
expected: Show the files that will be committed, or commit only staged changes.
actual: Unrelated local edits are committed together with the agent's.
impact: Unwanted commits that must be undone by hand.
fix: List workingTreeChanges in a modal before committing, or commit the index only; use PRODUCT_NAMES in the warning.
verify: Manual: modify two files, run Git Commit, see both listed before confirming.

feature: Continue in the Cloud
title: Continue in the Cloud makes a new requestId on every attempt, so running it again after a timeout or the misleading failure message starts a second session.
expected: One key per hand-off, reused when the user repeats the same hand-off, so the server returns the existing session.
actual: Each rerun provisions another sandbox and can hit 'Your plan allows N active Code sessions'.
impact: Duplicate sessions and false plan-limit errors; same cause as the mobile Start session finding.
fix: Derive the key from the hand-off (workspace, branch, goal) or keep it until the hand-off succeeds.
verify: Test: two calls for the same hand-off send the same requestId.

feature: Trusted contact
title: The Security pane shows Trusted contact · Not configured although there is no way to configure one.
expected: Either no row, or plain copy that the feature is not offered.
actual: Users look for a setup control that does not exist.
impact: Minor confusion; reads as a broken or missing control.
fix: Change heading to Trusted contact and the body to say it is not offered, or remove the section.
verify: SecuritySection test asserts the new copy.

feature: Compare plans page
title: Unused pricing strings that contradict current policy ship in every locale bundle.
expected: Locale files carry only live, accurate strings.
actual: Dead, contradictory copy is bundled and can be revived by mistake.
impact: Translators maintain wrong text; risk of misleading copy if reused.
fix: Delete the unused keys from every locale and add a check for unreferenced pricing keys.
verify: Grep shows no remaining keys; i18n tests pass.

feature: Display language and interface languages
title: Choosing Spanish translates only menus, navigation and pricing; about 24 of 1,029 web components use translations.
expected: Documented partial scope (as now).
actual: Most of the product stays English after switching.
impact: Spanish speakers see a mostly English app; disclosed.
fix: None required now; extend coverage before adding languages.
verify: n/a

feature: Share a single response
title: 'Share answer' creates no link: it hands plain text to the OS share sheet or, where that API is missing, silently does the same as Copy.
expected: A share action produces a viewable link (as chat sharing does via /api/share), or the item is labelled Copy text / Share text.
actual: No link; desktop browsers without Web Share get a duplicate Copy button, and formatting, citations and images are dropped.
impact: Users expecting a link get raw text; the feature map row calling this Same overstates it.
fix: Create a single-message share through the existing /api/share snapshot path (one assistant turn plus its prompt), or rename the item to 'Share text' and hide it where navigator.share is absent.
verify: Test that clicking Share answer POSTs to the share route and shows a link; or that the label matches behaviour.

feature: Edit a sent message
title: The Edit button on your own message stays enabled while a reply streams, and clicking it does nothing.
expected: Edit is disabled with a tooltip while a reply runs, like Retry.
actual: Click is ignored silently.
impact: Looks broken; users click repeatedly.
fix: Pass disabled={isConversationStreaming} to the Edit button and add the reason to its tooltip.
verify: Component test: with isConversationStreaming true the Edit button is disabled.

feature: Timestamp of a message
title: 'Sent at' shows only the hour and minute, so messages from earlier days show no date unless you hover.
expected: Show the date when the message is not from today.
actual: 'Sent at 10:42' for a message from last month.
impact: Misleading time for older chats; hidden on touch.
fix: Use a relative date format (today: time; otherwise date and time).
verify: Component test with a timestamp from a prior day expects the date in the label.

feature: Search past chats
title: Search does not escape LIKE wildcards, so a query containing % or _ matches unrelated chats.
expected: Literal search for the characters typed.
actual: Searching '_' or '100%' returns wildcard matches.
impact: Noisy results for queries with these characters.
fix: Escape backslash, % and _ in q with the existing escapeIlike helper (apps/web/lib/server/media-assets.ts:374) and add ESCAPE to each ilike.
verify: Route test: q='_' does not match a title 'ab'.

feature: Share link creation (title menu Share)
title: Sharing right after stopping an answer before any text appeared can be refused as 'changes not saved yet', because the stored row holds a zero-width placeholder the local row lacks.
expected: An empty stopped answer matches its stored row and the chat shares.
actual: Likely refusal until reload. Not closed: whether the server's own snapshot (content '') wins the row over the client save.
impact: Misleading error; user retries without success.
fix: Normalise U+200B to '' in transcriptKey (both sides) or set the local content to the same placeholder.
verify: Route test: stored content '\u200b' and submitted '' for an assistant turn is accepted.

feature: Plus menu: take a screenshot
title: Screen capture exists in the shared attachment menu but is not offered in the web composer.
expected: Owner decides whether web should offer it.
actual: Not on web.
impact: Parity gap only.
fix: Reuse the AttachmentMenu capture helper in ComposerPlusMenu if wanted.
verify: Manual: plus menu shows Take screenshot.

feature: Report a response
title: 'Report this response' files every report as 'harmful' in one click, with no reason picker, note or confirmation, though the backend takes six categories and mobile asks for one.
expected: A small dialog asks why (category plus optional note) before sending, as on mobile and in the leaders.
actual: One accidental click files a 'harmful' report with no context.
impact: Trust and safety triage gets mislabelled reports; users cannot say what was wrong.
fix: Reuse the mobile category list in a web dialog; send the chosen category and note; drop the 'unknown' conversation fallback.
verify: Component test: Report opens a dialog; the POST body carries the chosen category.

feature: Retry a response
title: With the message-variants kill switch on, regenerating an earlier answer deletes it and every later message without asking.
expected: Any regenerate that will delete later turns asks first and names how many, as the user-retry path does.
actual: Later turns are deleted once the new answer commits, without a prompt.
impact: Only when the kill switch is used, but then later messages are lost silently.
fix: Set discarded = plan.rollbackIds.length - 2 for assistant regenerates (excluding the user turn and the regenerated answer) and confirm when above zero.
verify: Test with variants off: regenerate the first of two answers; expect a confirmation naming 2 messages.

feature: Pin an individual message
title: Pinning a message only draws a small icon next to it; there is no list of pinned messages and no way to jump to them, and the icon is hidden from screen readers.
expected: Pinned messages can be found again (a list in the header or a search filter), and the badge has an accessible label.
actual: A pin is a decoration on one bubble in a long, virtualised transcript.
impact: The feature map's 'Better' rating is not earned; screen-reader users cannot tell a message is pinned.
fix: Add a Pinned messages popover in the conversation header that scrolls to each one, and give the badge an sr-only 'Pinned' label.
verify: Pin two messages and open the list; each entry scrolls to its message. axe check on the badge.

feature: Citations with hover preview and a sources list
title: A grouped citation chip ('site +2') opens only the first source; the other sources appear in a hover tooltip as plain text that cannot be clicked, focused or opened on touch.
expected: Each grouped source can be opened by mouse, keyboard and touch (a popover with links, as in the leaders).
actual: Sources 2..n of a group are reachable only through the separate Sources panel.
impact: Keyboard, screen-reader and phone-browser users lose access to most grouped sources inline.
fix: Swap the tooltip for a popover on click/focus whose rows are links.
verify: Keyboard test: Tab to the chip, open it, Tab to source 2, Enter opens it.

feature: Chat row menu: Mark as unread
title: Mark as unread is stored only in this browser, so it does not follow the user to other devices or apps; the 'Better' rating overstates it.
expected: An owner decision: keep it per device, or add a server column so web, desktop and mobile agree.
actual: Per-browser only.
impact: Minor inconsistency across devices.
fix: If cross-device is wanted, add an unread_at column to web_conversations and sync it with the other conversation flags.
verify: Mark unread on web, open mobile; the row shows unread.

feature: Feature map accuracy (rows 52, 105, 107)
title: Three feature-map rows describe the code wrongly: Send with Enter already exists, a notification offer already shows during long tasks, and row 107 points at a render-crash boundary instead of the turn failure notice.
expected: The comparison reflects the code.
actual: Row 52 is scored Missing and rows 105 and 107 cite the wrong evidence.
impact: A feature that exists could be rebuilt.
fix: Mark row 52 Same (desktop-only at ChatGPT), update row 105 to note the banner, and point row 107 at turn-error-notice.ts.
verify: Re-read the three rows against the cited files.

feature: Chat row menu: Move to project
title: There is no way to take a chat out of a project on web: Move to project lists only projects and nothing sends projectId null.
expected: A 'Remove from project' choice, as ChatGPT offers.
actual: A chat moved into a project by mistake can only be moved to another project or deleted.
impact: Users cannot undo a move; chats stay scoped to project instructions and knowledge.
fix: Add a 'Remove from project' item (projectId: null) to the row submenu and the bulk Move menu when the chat has a project.
verify: Unit test the submenu renders the item for a session with projectId and calls onMoveToProject(id, null).

feature: Greeting on the empty home screen
title: The greeting first shows the user's name and then removes it for someone who switched names off, and for others it renders nameless then pops the name in.
expected: An opted-out user never sees their name; the headline waits until the name source is settled.
actual: Name appears for a fetch round trip, then disappears; or the nameless variant shows and is replaced.
impact: Visible headline jump on every load; the name the user asked not to use flashes on screen (screen sharing).
fix: Treat the opt-out as unknown until fetched (null) and hold the headline, or render from nameResolved && optOutKnown.
verify: Hook test: stored preferredName '' and a slow fetch; assert the headline never contains the account name.

feature: Get apps / Download apps link
title: The desktop download link exists only in WebAppShell's footer; the main /chat page hand-builds its own footer without it.
expected: One footer component on every signed-in page; download link hidden inside the desktop host.
actual: Users on /chat, where they spend most time, never see Get apps; two footers drift.
impact: The 'Same' rating for Get apps holds only on secondary pages; desktop users may be offered the app they are in.
fix: Use AccountFooter in WebChatPage and pass desktopDownload only when !isDesktopHost().
verify: Render /chat sidebar and assert the 'Download' link; desktop host test asserts it is absent.

feature: Command palette
title: The command palette's model list offers every Max-tier chat model and a New AGI Work action to every account, ignoring the plan locks the composer picker shows.
expected: The palette lists the same entitled models as the picker (locked ones marked) and hides Work for plans without it.
actual: A Free user can select a Max-only model from the palette; what the next send does was not traced (server refusal or reroute suspected). New AGI Work silently opens a normal chat.
impact: Free and Premium users get a choice the app then does not honour; misleading.
fix: Build the palette list from useModelCatalogue with entitlement, route selection through the composer's model-change handler, and gate New AGI Work on canUseAgiWork.
verify: Palette test with a Free billing store: a Max-only model is absent or disabled; New AGI Work hidden.

feature: Running dot and unread dot on chat rows
title: The running dot reflects only streams in this browser tab, so a Work task running on the server shows no dot after a reload or on another device.
expected: A server-side running run marks its row, as the needs_you flag already does.
actual: After reload, a long Work task looks idle until it finishes or needs input.
impact: Users start duplicate tasks or think the task stalled.
fix: Add a CONVERSATION_RUNNING_SELECT (state in queued/running) next to needs_you and map it to runState.
verify: API test: a conversation with a running cloud_agent_runs row returns running:true; sidebar shows session-running.

feature: Chats and tasks list with filter facets
title: Search on /chat/chats filters only the titles already loaded, then says 'Nothing matches' even when older chats would match.
expected: Search covers all chats (or says it searched only loaded ones); bulk archive confirms with Undo.
actual: Older matching chats are reported as absent; archived rows vanish silently.
impact: Users conclude a chat is gone; accidental bulk archive has no one-click undo.
fix: Query /api/search (or page through) when the query is non-empty and hasMore; add success toast with Undo for bulk archive.
verify: Test with hasMoreConversations=true and a query that matches nothing loaded: the copy must not claim no match.

feature: Study destination
title: Starting a study session creates the conversation first, and if the study start call fails the empty titled conversation is left behind.
expected: A failed start leaves no stray chat, or reuses the one already created.
actual: Each failed attempt adds an empty 'Study: <topic>' chat to the sidebar.
impact: Clutter of empty chats; confusing history.
fix: On api.start failure delete the created conversation (or keep its id and reuse it on retry).
verify: StudyPage test with api.start rejecting: createConversation called once per click and deleteConversation called.

feature: Plus menu: add to project; Chat | Work mode switch
title: On AGI Work plans a project scope and Chat mode cannot coexist on /chat: picking a project switches to Work and choosing Chat removes the project.
expected: Paid users can start an ordinary chat inside a project, as Free users can.
actual: Every paid project chat started from /chat is a Work task (autonomy, approvals).
impact: Premium and higher users cannot keep a plain chat in a project; owner should confirm this is wanted.
fix: If not intended: let projectId travel in Chat mode and stop clearing the project on Chat.
verify: Composer test with canUseAgiWork: select project, switch to Chat, assert project kept.

feature: Plus menu: add connector (browse, custom)
title: 'Manage connectors' and 'Browse connectors' in the plus menu are two rows that open the same settings section.
expected: Browse opens the connector directory (or one row is removed).
actual: Two identical destinations under different names.
impact: Minor confusion; looks unfinished.
fix: Point Browse at the directory view (e.g. a browse tab or query) or drop one row.
verify: Menu test asserts the two rows navigate to different targets.

feature: Copy a response
title: The Copy button on a message calls the clipboard without a try/catch, so a denied or unavailable clipboard fails with no message.
expected: Copy failure shows 'Could not copy' like the other copy controls.
actual: Nothing happens and an unhandled rejection is logged.
impact: Users think the text was copied.
fix: Wrap in try/catch (or safeClipboard.writeText as WebChatPage uses) and toast on failure.
verify: Unit test with writeText rejecting: expect toast.error and no 'Copied' state.

feature: Read a response aloud
title: Read aloud speaks the raw markdown source, so every chart, card, checklist or other answer block is read as 'code block omitted' and inline code is skipped mid-sentence.
expected: Read aloud uses the same plain-text rendering as Copy, reading block contents and inline code.
actual: 'Run to install' for 'Run `npm i` to install'; a card answer is read as repeated 'code block omitted'.
impact: Read aloud is unusable for rich answers, which the system prompt now encourages.
fix: Feed richBlocksAsPlainText(content) to speak and keep inline code text.
verify: useTTS unit test: stripMarkdown('Run `npm i`') contains 'npm i'; a ```cards fence yields its titles.

feature: Interactive controls with live readouts (radio, slider, checkbox, dropdown)
title: The slider block has no step, so fractional ranges snap to whole numbers, and its value readout is not announced.
expected: Step derived from the values' precision; readout exposed as output; feature copy matches what controls do.
actual: Decimal sliders jump between integers; screen readers miss the readout.
impact: Controls look broken for common fractional cases.
fix: Add a step field (default from decimals in min/max/value) and render the value in <output aria-live='polite'>.
verify: Unit test: parseSlider('min: 0\nmax: 1\nvalue: 0.25') renders a range with step 0.01 and value 0.25.

feature: Pinned and recent chats lists with projects in the sidebar
title: The sidebar's Organize chats choice is plain component state, so it resets to By project on every reload and when moving between /chat and other pages.
expected: The choice persists like other sidebar preferences (hiddenNavIds are in the settings store).
actual: Users who pick 'In one list' lose it on the next navigation.
impact: Minor annoyance; combined with the project-chat gaps above, users fall back to the limited view.
fix: Store organizeMode in useSettingsStore (synced preferences).
verify: Test: set one-list, remount Sidebar, assert one-list remains.

feature: Feature map accuracy (Inline interactive visuals; Get apps; controls)
title: Three rows in this unit describe the code wrongly.
expected: Rows match the implementation.
actual: Ratings rest on code paths users do not reach or that behave differently.
impact: Planning decisions made on wrong ratings.
fix: Update the comparison rows.
verify: Re-read rows against the cited files.

feature: Chat | Work mode switch
title: The project page composer takes whatever Chat or Work mode was last set on the /chat home composer and offers no switch to change it.
expected: The project composer shows the mode it will send and lets the user change it, or uses its own default.
actual: A user who left /chat in Work sends a Work task from the project page with no way to choose Chat there.
impact: Surprise Work runs; the 'New chat in <project>' placeholder is replaced by the Work prompt.
fix: Pass a projectPicker (or a mode prop) to the project page composer, or key its toggles separately.
verify: Test: set PENDING workMode agiwork, render the project page composer, assert a visible Chat | Work control.

feature: Citations (citation answer block)
title: The ```citation answer block renders its url as a raw link, skipping the URL safety transform and new-tab handling every other answer link gets.
expected: Citation links get the same protocol allowlist, tracking-param stripping and new-tab behaviour as markdown links.
actual: Any scheme is linked; clicking replaces the chat page.
impact: Lost place in the chat; injected content can launch external protocol handlers (browser prompts first).
fix: Run href through the same transform as MarkdownLink (http/https/mailto only) and render with target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer.
verify: Unit test: a citation block with url 'vbscript:x' or 'file:///etc' renders no <a>; an https url gets target _blank.

feature: Collapse the sidebar to an icon rail
title: Ctrl/Cmd+B flips a hidden preference when the sidebar is in rail or drawer mode, so it does nothing visible and the sidebar comes back in the opposite state later.
expected: The key does what the toggle button does in the current mode (open the drawer in rail/drawer mode).
actual: No visible change; after closing the panel the sidebar is collapsed or expanded contrary to what the user last saw.
impact: Keyboard users think the shortcut is broken.
fix: Route the shortcut through the same mode-aware handler the Sidebar gets (open the drawer when rail or drawer).
verify: Test: with activeSecondaryPanel set, press Ctrl+B and assert mobileNavOpen true and sidebarCollapsed unchanged.

feature: Image aspect ratio choice
title: The web image picker keeps its own aspect ratio table that has drifted from the catalog and the server: Gemini's 1:4, 4:1, 1:8 and 8:1 are missing and 9:21 is listed but never offered.
expected: One owner for per-API aspect ratios (AGENTS.md sections 3 and 4); the web picker reads the catalog helper.
actual: Three tables; the web offers fewer ratios than the server accepts and carries a dead 9:21 option.
impact: Web users cannot pick banner or column ratios the model supports; future table edits will drift further.
fix: Delete the web table and use getImageAspectOptionsForModel from @agiworkforce/types (adding 'auto' in the picker); make the server table derive from the same source.
verify: Unit test that the web picker options for each live image model equal the catalog helper's options plus Auto.

feature: Usage warning on heavy models
title: The heavy-model usage warning exists only as a hover tooltip on a non-focusable span, so keyboard, screen reader and touch users never get it.
expected: The warning is visible in the row (guidance line or badge) or announced in its accessible name, as the degraded and deprecation notes are.
actual: Only a mouse hover reveals it.
impact: Users on phones and assistive tech pick heavy models without the warning the comparison credits us for.
fix: Show the warning in the guidance line or a small badge and append it to the row aria-label.
verify: Component test: a premium model row's accessible name includes the usage warning; visible without hover.

feature: Interrupt or steer research while it runs
title: Resume on a paused or failed research run reports success and silently does nothing when another reply is streaming.
expected: Resume is disabled while another reply streams, or shows why it did not start, and the handler returns false when nothing was sent.
actual: The click does nothing and gives no feedback.
impact: Users think resume is broken or wait for a run that never started.
fix: Return a boolean from handleRetryResearch, return it from the handler, and disable Resume while isStreaming with a reason.
verify: Component test: with isStreaming true, Resume is disabled or shows a notice; handler returns false.

feature: Voice conversation mode
title: A microphone that another app is using (NotReadableError) is reported as 'The voice connection could not be established' instead of a microphone problem.
expected: A busy or failing microphone says so and suggests closing the other app or choosing another microphone.
actual: The user is told the connection failed and may retry a network problem that does not exist.
impact: Confusing failure with no path to fix it.
fix: Map NotReadableError and AbortError to a microphone-busy message with its own code.
verify: Unit test: getUserMedia rejecting with NotReadableError yields the microphone-busy code and message.

feature: Hands-free and push-to-talk choices
title: Web voice has no push-to-talk while the phone app offers it in voice settings.
expected: Same voice input modes across surfaces, or a recorded deviation.
actual: Web is hands-free only.
impact: Parity gap; not a defect in shipped controls.
fix: Add a push-to-talk mode to web voice settings driving session.input_audio.mute/unmute, which the session already allows (sessions/route.ts:138-147).
verify: Manual: with push-to-talk on, audio is sent only while the key or button is held.

feature: Missing rows (location, booking, audio and video attach, GIF output)
title: Confirmed absent: search location, restaurant booking, audio and video attachments, and GIF image output; no half-built code found.
expected: Owner decides whether to build these.
actual: Absent as the comparison says.
impact: Comparison gaps only.
fix: None unless the owner chooses to build them.
verify: Not applicable.

feature: Voice, language and speed settings
title: Changing the voice in the settings opened during a live voice session does nothing to that session and nothing says it applies next time.
expected: The voice picker says the new voice starts with the next session, or the session restarts with it.
actual: The picker shows the new voice while the old voice keeps speaking.
impact: Users think the voice change is broken.
fix: Show 'From your next voice session' under the voice picker while a session is live, or offer a restart with the new voice.
verify: Component test: with a live session, changing voice shows the next-session note.

feature: Pair a phone or browser with a desktop computer
title: The public /pair page tells people to scan a pairing QR code with the phone app, which has no pairing screen in v1.
expected: While Remote Control is hidden on the phone, /pair says pairing is not available yet (or the route is not linked), instead of giving steps.
actual: The page gives step-by-step pairing instructions that cannot be completed on any released phone build.
impact: Anyone who lands on /pair follows steps that dead-end, then contacts support.
fix: Gate the PairBody copy on the same release flag that hides Remote Control (or a shared surface-status entry) and show a not available yet message with the availability link.
verify: Render test for /pair with the companion feature off expects the unavailable copy and no step list.

feature: Capabilities switches for Artifacts, Inline visualizations and code execution
title: The Artifacts and Inline visualizations switches never appear, and the prompt code that would honour them has no caller.
expected: Either wire the request path to read capabilities.artifacts and inlineVisualizations into capabilityPreferences and report the switches, or remove the unused branches until the switches ship.
actual: Users see only Cloud code execution and Tool access. The comparison row claims Artifacts and Inline visualizations switches that do not render; the prompt branches are dead in production.
impact: Users cannot turn artifacts or inline charts off, unlike Claude. Internally, a test passes over code no request reaches.
fix: Load the capabilities namespace in the chat request processor and pass capabilityPreferences into prompt assembly, then add the two keys to AVAILABLE_CAPABILITY_SWITCHES; or delete the dead branches and the test.
verify: Request-processor test: with artifacts:false and cloudCodeExecution:false saved, the assembled system prompt omits the artifact section; settings render test shows both switches.

feature: Version history, restore and diff review of an artifact
title: Versions made by hand edits live only in this browser: the server records them but nothing reads them back, so that history is gone on another device or after signing out.
expected: Version history, restore and Show changes follow the account like the artifact itself, since the server already keeps the versions.
actual: On a second device, in Desktop, or after sign-out, in-panel edits collapse to the latest content; earlier hand-edited versions cannot be restored or diffed.
impact: People who edit artifacts by hand and switch devices; the Better claim holds for hand edits only within one browser profile.
fix: Add a read route for web_artifact_versions (owner-scoped, paginated) and hydrate versionsById from it when an artifact opens; keep local versions only as an unsynced overlay.
verify: Integration test: push two versions via /api/chat/sync, clear local storage, open the artifact, and expect the stepper to show 2 and restore version 1.

feature: Turn memory off for one chat from the + menu
title: Turning memory off for one chat is stored only in this browser, so the same chat uses memory again on another device or after signing out.
expected: A per-chat memory choice is saved with the conversation so every device and surface honours it, like the chat's project, model and draft.
actual: The chat silently reads and writes memory when continued on the phone, in Desktop, in another browser, or after sign-out and sign-in.
impact: Users who turned memory off for a sensitive chat get it remembered elsewhere; low frequency but a privacy expectation.
fix: Store a memory_disabled flag on web_conversations (PATCH and sync), read it server-side in turn context, and hydrate the toggle from the conversation.
verify: Route test: PATCH memoryDisabled true, then a turn without the client flag loads no memory block; UI test hydrates the toggle from the server row.

feature: Share a project with teammates (view or edit)
title: Shared-project copy says only the owner can add or remove sources, but members with Can edit can.
expected: Copy says the owner or people with edit access can add sources, and the help article mentions Can edit.
actual: Viewers are told to ask only the owner; editors reading the help think they cannot add sources.
impact: Minor confusion for workspace members.
fix: Change the read-only empty state to 'Only the owner and people who can edit can add or remove them' and update content/support/projects.md Shared projects.
verify: SourcesPanel render test for readOnly copy; support-claims check passes.

feature: Send a document as a Gmail or Outlook draft; Save an artifact to Google Docs, Google Drive or OneDrive
title: Gmail draft actions and Save to Google Docs, Drive and OneDrive exist but stay hidden behind the unreleased connectors switch.
expected: Stays hidden until the connectors are released (owner decision recorded in policy-versions.json).
actual: Backend and menu code ship dark; rows 12 and 13 read Missing to users.
impact: None today; a release flip would expose code that has not run in production.
fix: None now; before release add an end-to-end test per destination.
verify: With connectors released in a test, the three menu items appear and each route saves a file.

feature: Apps made in chat can call the AI themselves (AI-powered artifacts)
title: AI calls from published apps are fully routed but switched off by AGI_ARTIFACT_AI_ENABLED until a security review passes.
expected: Hidden until the review passes.
actual: Row 20 reads Missing; code is present and dark.
impact: None today.
fix: None now.
verify: n/a

feature: Project row menu in the sidebar
title: The sidebar offers Rename, Pin and Delete on projects shared with you, which the server refuses for non-owners.
expected: Rows for shared projects show only open, new chat and, for editors, settings.
actual: Members see Delete project and Pin; choosing them flashes the row away and back with an error.
impact: Workspace members get confusing failures and may think they deleted a teammate's project.
fix: Carry isOrgShared and sharedAccess into SidebarProject and omit owner-only items for shared rows.
verify: Sidebar test: a shared project row renders no Delete, Rename or Pin items.

feature: Edit part of a document with AI (select text, then Edit with AI or Improve)
title: Edit with AI on a selection asks the model to rewrite the whole artifact and only instructs it to keep the rest; nothing checks that it did.
expected: A targeted replace of the selected range, or a check that unselected text is unchanged before the result becomes the next version.
actual: Long documents are regenerated in full, costing output tokens, and the model can alter or truncate other sections.
impact: Silent edits outside the selection on long documents; higher cost per edit.
fix: Add an artifact patch tool (find and replace on the stored content) for selection edits, or diff the reply against the prior version outside the selected range and warn.
verify: Test that a selection edit on a 20-section document changes only the selected section.

feature: Connect project and developer tools (Notion, Jira, Linear, Sentry and similar)
title: When the in-chat Connect link is refused for plan, policy, unconfirmed email or coming soon, the user is sent back with no message.
expected: The user sees why (upgrade needed, admin blocked it, confirm your email, coming soon).
actual: The page reloads and nothing happens.
impact: Narrow: connector tools are already withheld from Free and policy-blocked turns, so the card reaches this only when the plan, workspace policy or email state changed after the card was shown. Those users get no feedback.
fix: Add policy_blocked (and plan_required) outcomes, or carry the gate code in the redirect so the toast can name the reason; or make the card call mode=json like the settings adapter.
verify: Hook test: status=policy_blocked produces an error toast. Manual: Free account clicks Connect in a chat card.

feature: Health: records and health chats kept apart
title: The Health space appears when the HealthEx OAuth app is configured, although that connector is not released and cannot be connected.
expected: The Health space shows only when its connector can actually be connected.
actual: If the OAuth app is configured in production, US users see a Health space whose main action fails.
impact: Depends on whether the HealthEx client is configured in production (not verifiable from the repo).
fix: Add connectorReleased(HEALTHEX_CONNECTOR_ID) to healthSpaceUnavailableReason.
verify: Unit test: configured but unreleased returns a reason; check production env.

feature: Send a task to your own computer and follow it from the browser (Dispatch, Remote)
title: The Your computer page asks users to pair Desktop, which is marked Coming soon.
expected: Hide the page, or say Desktop is coming soon instead of giving pairing steps.
actual: Users can reach a flow they cannot complete.
impact: Small: the rail item is unpinned by default.
fix: Gate the rail item and the page on SURFACE_STATUS.desktop, or show a coming-soon state.
verify: Component test: with desktop coming soon, the page shows the coming-soon copy.

feature: Personal Finance: balances and spending from linked banks
title: A Finances page and live bank-account routes exist with no navigation entry and a switched-off connector.
expected: Either finish and release it, or remove the page and routes until the owner decides.
actual: Reachable only by URL; connecting a bank is refused as coming soon.
impact: Dead surface and maintenance cost; no user-visible harm.
fix: Owner decision: ship behind the release list or delete the page and routes.
verify: Grep for /chat/finance links after the change.

feature: Start Work from a file, artifact, page or connector result
title: Start Work is offered on artifacts to plans without Work, and the request is silently sent as an ordinary chat.
expected: Hide the item, or show the Work upgrade message, when the plan lacks agi_work.
actual: The control looks like it starts Work but does not.
impact: Free and Basic users get a weaker answer than the label promises.
fix: Gate the menu item on the canUseAgiWork capability, or have startWork show the upgrade prompt.
verify: Component test: with a Free plan the item is absent or shows the upgrade message.

feature: Surface relevant connectors during a conversation (connector search)
title: The new-chat connector suggestion card is shown to plans that cannot use connectors.
expected: Free accounts do not get a 'connect your apps' prompt, or the card says connectors need a paid plan.
actual: Free users are sent to a settings pane that refuses the connection.
impact: Small dead end for every Free account.
fix: Hide the card unless the canUseConnectors capability is granted.
verify: Component test with canUseConnectors false renders nothing.

feature: Run a task in a Cloud Code session
title: A Cloud Code turn that outlasts the request is shown on web as a failed turn with Retry, although it is still running.
expected: A still-running turn stays shown as running and is followed until it settles, as on mobile.
actual: Traced in code, not run: the record becomes an error (carrying the server's 'still running' text) with Retry and the prompt restored; the finished turn shows only after the session is reopened, beside the stale error record, which has no turnId to merge on (620-627).
impact: Users may think a long task failed and send it again.
fix: Handle the turn_still_running reason: keep the record running and poll the session's turns.
verify: Test: mock a 409 with reason turn_still_running and assert the record stays running with no Retry.

feature: Read page structure or find elements
title: The background forwards any message type it does not name to any tab's content script under a cross-tab default, so an unapproved tab's page HTML can be read through it.
expected: Unknown message types are rejected; cross-tab page reads exist only as explicit, origin-authorized cases.
actual: A content script on an approved site, if its renderer is compromised, can ask for the HTML, text or accessibility tree of any other tab, including blocked and banking tabs. No runtime sender in product code needs the default branch.
impact: The defense in depth the message policy is built for is missing on its catch-all; message-policy-coverage.test.ts checks only explicit cases.
fix: Reject unlisted types in handleMessage (the runtime entry) and make getMessagePolicy deny them, keeping the in-process Desktop call; delete GET_ACCESSIBILITY_TREE and the unused CLICK, TYPE and WAIT_FOR_SELECTOR runtime paths.
verify: Extend message-policy-coverage.test.ts: an unlisted type from an approved-tab sender is rejected and never reaches tabs.sendMessage.
